title: Home practical guide and safety card: pendulum
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Review of Key Stage 3 and working scientifically (9C)
source: Written for science/y9 lesson 45 (Home practical guide and safety card: pendulum (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 45: Planning a safe investigation. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out how the length of a pendulum changes its time for one swing
equipment: A small weight (a washer or key)
Tape to fix the string to a table edge
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Tie the weight to the string and tape it so 25 cm hangs down
Pull it a small way to one side and let go
Change the length to 50, 75 and 100 cm
Find the mean for each length and draw a line graph
